weapons.name: Security-380 .380 Auto
weapons.source_note: Ruger model 3839 specification sheet: "Caliber: 380 Auto", "Grooves 6", "Twist 1:10\" RH". States a six-groove right-hand 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: KORD Heavy Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: GunSpec.io entry for the Kord 6P50 (V.A. Degtyarev Plant): "Barrel Rifling Right Hand Rifling Twist 381 mm (15.00\")" and "Number of Grooves 8". States an eight-groove right-hand twist of 381 mm per turn (about 1 turn in 15 inches). The 6P49/6P50/6P51 operating manual confirms the barrel has eight grooves turning left to right, but does not print the pitch.

weapons.name: NSV 'Utes' Heavy Machine Gun
weapons.source_note: Weaponsystems.net NSV entry, specification table: "Rifling 8 grooves, 381 mm right hand twist". States an eight-groove right-hand twist of 381 mm per turn (about 1 turn in 15 inches).

weapons.name: 100 .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Sako 100 Explorer configuration table: the .308 Win. columns of the RATE OF TWIST row read "1:10\"". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: 85 Black .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Sako 85 Black Bear specification sheet, "ACTION SIZE / CALIBER / RATE OF TWIST": "S / 308 Win / 11\"". States a 1 turn in 11 inch twist = 279.4 mm per turn for the .308 Win chambering. Sako's 85 Synthetic Black sheet gives the same .308 Win 11\" rate.

weapons.name: 85 Finnlight .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Sako 85 Finnlight specification sheet, "ACTION SIZE / CALIBER / RATE OF TWIST": "S / 308 Win / 11\"". States a 1 turn in 11 inch twist = 279.4 mm per turn for the .308 Win chambering.

weapons.name: S20 Hunter .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Sako S20 Hunter configuration table, CALIBER paired with RATE OF TWIST: "308 Win." = "1:10\"". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: S20 Precision .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Sako S20 Precision configuration table, row "Caliber = Rate of twist": "308 Win. = 1:10\"". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: TRG-22 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Sako TRG 22/42 Owner's Manual, technical data table: ".308 Win ... Rate of twist and direction of rotation 280 mm (11\"), RH". The manual gives the pitch as 11 inches (written 280 mm); 1 turn in 11 inches = 279.4 mm per turn. The TRG 22 A1 instruction manual gives the same .308 Win / 11\".

weapons.name: 110 Scout V2 5.56 NATO
weapons.source_note: Savage 110 Scout V2 (SKU 32982) specification table: "Caliber 5.56x45mm NATO" and "Rate of Twist 1:7\"". States a 1 turn in 7 inch twist = 177.8 mm per turn.

weapons.name: 110 Trail Hunter .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: Savage 110 Trail Hunter, 308 Win (SKU 58034) specification table: "Caliber 308 Win" and "Rate of Twist 1:10\"". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Impulse Core Hunter Pro 22 Creedmoor
weapons.source_note: Savage Impulse Core Hunter Pro, 22 Creedmoor (SKU 32921) specification table: "Caliber 22 Creedmoor" and "Rate of Twist 1:8\"". States a 1 turn in 8 inch twist = 203.2 mm per turn.

weapons.name: CROSS .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: Archived SIG Sauer CROSS product page, SKU comparison table row CROSS-308-16B: "308 Win", "16 in [406.4 mm]", "TWIST RATE 1:10". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn for the .308 Win 16 inch barrel.
